newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index drops by 3.85 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index drops by 3.85 pct.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed down 3.85 percent on Wednesday, largely driven by investment fund SPDIT-SICAF, which fell by 49.62 percent on its first day's trading on the computerised system which introduces greater price transparency, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 502.17 from 522.30 on Tuesday.
Volume was 273,389 dinars against 4.16 million dinars.
SPDIT-SICAF dropped by 17.72 dinars to 17.99 dinars. Brokers linked the the fall to the introduction of computerised dealing, with its greater price transparency.

Since last October, the Tunis Stock Exchange has been gradually introducing computerised dealing for listed companies, with the system now 23 out of 31 shares. Most of the computerised shares dropped sharply when they made the switch.
Brokers said they expect more firms to register a sharp adjustment of their prices before wide spreads between bids and offers are reconciled on the computerised system.
Eight banks are still traded on the blackboard and are expected to join the others on the computerised system over the next few weeks.
Coke and beer bottler SFBT was down by 6.94 dinars to 75.5. Detergents firm SPCD eased 1.64 dinars to 26.36 dinars.
Banque de Tunisie declined by one dinar to 73.5 dinars. Banque du Sud edged 0.8 dinar lower to 25.77 dinars. STB bank was down 0.61 dinar to 19.84 dinars.
Chemical firm Al-Kimia rose 0.48 dinar to 42.98 dinars. BDET bank was up 0.46 dinar to 16.46 dinars. BIAT bank gained 0.4 dinar to 31 dinars. ($= 1.04 dinars)
